title: My Way
syncedLyrics:
[00:06.16] And now, the end is near
[00:11.51] And so I face the final curtain
[00:18.68] My friend, I'll say it clear
[00:24.07] I'll state my case, of which I'm certain
[00:30.69] I've lived a life that's full
[00:36.71] I traveled each and every highway
[00:43.20] And more, much more than this
[00:48.92] I did it my way
[00:56.39] Regrets, I've had a few
[01:01.76] But then again, too few to mention
[01:08.72] I did what I had to do
[01:14.43] And saw it through without exemption
[01:21.36] I planned each charted course
[01:26.80] Each careful step along the byway
[01:33.91] And more, much more than this
[01:39.44] I did it my way
[01:45.70] Yes, there were times, I'm sure you knew
[01:51.84] When I bit off more than I could chew
[01:58.32] But through it all, when there was doubt
[02:04.77] I ate it up and spit it out
[02:11.01] I faced it all, and I stood tall
[02:17.33] And did it my way
[02:24.12] I've loved, I've laughed and cried
[02:29.93] I've had my fill, my share of losing
[02:36.91] And now, as tears subside
[02:42.74] I find it all so amusing
[02:49.18] To think I did all that
[02:55.00] And may I say, not in a shy way
[03:02.08] Oh, no, oh, no, not me
[03:07.78] I did it my way
[03:13.75] For what is a man, what has he got?
[03:20.34] If not himself, then he has naught
[03:26.49] To say the things he truly feels
[03:33.44] And not the words of one who kneels
[03:39.91] The record shows I took the blows
[03:46.89] And did it my way
[03:59.94] 
[04:13.55] Yes, it was my way
[04:24.32]

And now, the end is near
And so I face the final curtain
My friend, I'll say it clear

I've lived a life that's full
I traveled each and every highway

I did it my way

I planned each charted course

I ate it up and spit it out

And did it my way

And now, as tears subside
